title: Percakapan Sehari-hari (Inggris)
sub: Pasar, restoran, taksi & kereta, wisata, hotel, arah & darurat
intro:
💬 Tentang kursus ini
Percakapan nyata untuk situasi sehari-hari: belanja dan menawar, restoran, taksi dan kereta, tempat wisata, hotel, serta arah jalan dan keadaan darurat. Setiap situasi berisi dialog bersuara, ungkapan kunci, dan tips budaya setempat. Latih dialognya di Latihan › Bermain Peran.
cando: Menanyakan harga, ukuran, dan menawar dengan sopan.
Memberi tujuan kepada sopir dan menanyakan ongkos.
Membeli tiket masuk dan menanyakan jam buka.

goals: Menanyakan harga, ukuran, dan menawar dengan sopan.

sections.html: Di Inggris, Amerika, dan Australia, harga di toko biasanya pas (tidak ditawar). Tawar-menawar hanya lazim di pasar loak (flea market) atau pasar suvenir. Orang sangat sering memakai please, thank you, dan sorry. Kasir biasanya bertanya "Cash or card?".
sections.title: 🌏 Tips budaya
Di pasar suvenir
lines: Seller
Hi there! Looking for anything in particular?
Halo! Sedang mencari sesuatu?
Rina
Just looking, thanks. Actually, how much is this scarf?
Lihat-lihat saja, terima kasih. Eh, syal ini berapa?
Seller
That one's twenty-five pounds. It's pure wool.
Yang itu 25 pound. Wol murni.
Rina
Hmm, that's a bit pricey. Could you do twenty?
Hmm, agak mahal. Bisa 20?
Seller
I can do twenty-two, and that's my best price.
Saya bisa kasih 22, itu harga terbaik saya.
Rina
Okay, deal. Do you take cards?
Oke, setuju. Bisa bayar pakai kartu?
Seller
Sure, just tap it here. Would you like a bag?
Bisa, tempelkan saja di sini. Mau pakai kantong?
Rina
No, I'm fine, thanks. Have a nice day!
Tidak usah, terima kasih. Semoga harimu menyenangkan!

sections.title: Ungkapan kunci
items: How much is this? / How much are these?
Do you have this in a smaller / larger size?
Ada ukuran yang lebih kecil / besar?
Could you do a better price?
Can I get a receipt, please?

goals: Menanyakan bahan makanan dan meminta tagihan.

sections.html: Di Amerika, pelayan mengharapkan tip sekitar 15–20%. Di Inggris dan Australia, tip bersifat sukarela (sekitar 10%), dan kadang sudah termasuk service charge. Untuk memanggil pelayan, cukup angkat tangan dan katakan "Excuse me". Jangan bersiul atau berteriak.
sections.title: 🌏 Tips budaya
Memesan makan malam
lines: Waiter
Good evening! Do you have a reservation?
Selamat malam! Sudah reservasi?
Budi
No, we don't. Do you have a table for two?
Belum. Ada meja untuk dua orang?
Waiter
Sure, follow me. Here are your menus. Can I get you something to drink?
Ada, mari ikut saya. Ini menunya. Mau minum apa dulu?
Budi
Two orange juices, please. Does the chicken pie have any pork or alcohol in it?
Dua jus jeruk. Apakah pai ayamnya mengandung babi atau alkohol?
Waiter
Let me check with the chef... No, it's just chicken and vegetables.
Saya tanyakan ke koki dulu... Tidak, isinya hanya ayam dan sayuran.
Budi
Great, I'll have the chicken pie, and my wife will have the grilled salmon.
Bagus, saya pesan pai ayam, dan istri saya salmon panggang.
Waiter
Excellent choice. Anything else?
Pilihan yang bagus. Ada lagi?
Budi
That's all for now, thanks. ... Excuse me, could we have the bill, please?
Itu dulu, terima kasih. ... Permisi, boleh minta tagihannya?

sections.title: Ungkapan kunci
items: Could I see the menu, please?
Is this halal? / Does it contain pork?
Apakah ini halal? / Apakah ada babinya?
Could we have the bill / check, please?
Can I get this to go?
sections.label: learn

items: What does Budi ask about the chicken pie?|the price|whether it has pork or alcohol|the size|the cooking time
What does Budi's wife order?|chicken pie|grilled salmon|orange juice only|soup
You want to take your leftover food home. You say ...|Can I get a box for this?|I want rubbish.|Bring the food out.|No food, please.
In the US, a usual tip is about ...|0%|5%|15–20%|50%

goals: Memberi tujuan kepada sopir dan menanyakan ongkos.

sections.html: Di kota besar, orang memakai aplikasi seperti Uber atau Grab, atau taksi resmi. Di London, kereta bawah tanah disebut the Tube (Amerika: subway). Bayar dengan kartu contactless langsung di gerbang. Saat antre, orang Inggris sangat menghargai queue, jadi jangan menyerobot.
sections.title: 🌏 Tips budaya
Naik taksi ke hotel
lines: Driver
Hi! Where to?
Halo! Ke mana?
Rina
The Grand Hotel on King Street, please.
Ke Grand Hotel di King Street.
Driver
No problem. Is this your first time in the city?
Baik. Ini pertama kali Anda ke kota ini?
Rina
Yes, it is. How long will it take?
Ya. Berapa lama perjalanannya?
Driver
About twenty minutes, depending on the traffic.
Sekitar dua puluh menit, tergantung lalu lintas.
Rina
Could you turn up the air conditioning a little?
Bisa AC-nya dinaikkan sedikit?
Driver
Sure. ... Here we are. That'll be eighteen fifty.
Tentu. ... Sudah sampai. Ongkosnya 18,50.
Rina
Here's twenty. Keep the change. Thank you!
Ini dua puluh. Kembaliannya ambil saja. Terima kasih!

sections.title: Membeli tiket kereta
lines: Budi
Hi, I'd like a return ticket to Oxford, please.
Halo, saya mau tiket pulang-pergi ke Oxford.
Clerk
Off-peak or anytime?
Di luar jam sibuk atau kapan saja?
Budi
Off-peak, please. What time is the next train?
Di luar jam sibuk. Kereta berikutnya jam berapa?
Clerk
There's one at 10:15 from platform 4. That's thirty-two pounds.
Ada jam 10.15 dari peron 4. Harganya 32 pound.
Budi
Do I need to change trains?
Apakah saya perlu ganti kereta?
Clerk
No, it's a direct train. It takes about an hour.
Tidak, langsung. Sekitar satu jam.

goals: Membeli tiket masuk dan menanyakan jam buka.
Meminta tolong difotokan dan bertanya tentang tempat.

sections.html: Banyak museum di London gratis (free admission), tetapi pengunjung diharapkan memberi donasi. Pelajar bisa meminta student discount dengan kartu pelajar. Minta izin sebelum memotret orang: "Do you mind if I take a photo?"
sections.title: 🌏 Tips budaya
Di loket museum
lines: Budi
Hello! Two adult tickets and one child, please.
Halo! Dua tiket dewasa dan satu anak.
Staff
That's forty-five pounds in total. Would you like an audio guide?
Totalnya 45 pound. Mau pemandu audio?
Budi
Is it available in Indonesian?
Ada dalam bahasa Indonesia?
Staff
I'm afraid not, but we have English, Arabic, and Chinese.
Sayangnya tidak, tapi ada Inggris, Arab, dan Mandarin.
Budi
English is fine. What time do you close?
Bahasa Inggris saja. Tutup jam berapa?
Staff
We close at half past five. The café is on the second floor.
Kami tutup jam setengah enam. Kafenya di lantai dua.
Budi
Is there a prayer room here?
Apakah di sini ada ruang sholat?
Staff
Yes, there's a quiet room next to the cloakroom.
Ada, ruang tenang di sebelah tempat penitipan barang.

sections.title: Minta tolong difotokan
lines: Rina
Excuse me, could you take a photo of us?
Permisi, bisa tolong fotokan kami?
Tourist
Of course! Just press this button? Say cheese!
Tentu! Tinggal tekan tombol ini? Senyum!
Rina
Could you take one more, with the tower in the background?
Bisa sekali lagi, dengan menara di belakang?
Tourist
Sure. ... There you go!
Tentu. ... Sudah!
Rina
Thank you so much! That's lovely.
Terima kasih banyak! Bagus sekali.

sections.title: Ungkapan kunci
items: How much is the entrance fee?
What time does it open / close?
Could you take a photo of us?
sections.label: learn

items: How much are the tickets in total?|£25|£45|£54|free
What time does the museum close?|5:00|5:30|6:30|7:00
Where is the quiet room?|on the second floor|next to the cloakroom|in the café|outside
You want to know if you can take pictures inside. You ask ...|Is photography allowed inside?|Can I photo?|Where is camera?|Do you sell photos?

sections.html: Hotel biasanya meminta kartu kredit sebagai jaminan (deposit). Waktu check-out umumnya pukul 11 atau 12. Jika ingin lebih lama, mintalah late check-out.
sections.title: 🌏 Tips budaya
Check-in
lines: Receptionist
Good afternoon! Welcome to the Grand Hotel. Checking in?
Selamat sore! Selamat datang di Grand Hotel. Mau check-in?
Budi
Yes, I have a reservation under the name Budi Santoso.
Ya, saya sudah reservasi atas nama Budi Santoso.
Receptionist
Let me see... A double room for three nights. May I see your passport, please?
Sebentar... Kamar dobel untuk tiga malam. Boleh lihat paspor Anda?
Budi
Here you are. Is breakfast included?
Ini. Apakah sudah termasuk sarapan?
Receptionist
Yes, it's served from seven to ten in the restaurant. Here's your key card. Room 512.
Ya, disajikan pukul tujuh sampai sepuluh di restoran. Ini kartu kuncinya. Kamar 512.
Budi
What's the Wi-Fi password?
Apa kata sandi Wi-Fi-nya?
Receptionist
It's on the back of your key card. Enjoy your stay!
Ada di balik kartu kunci. Selamat menginap!

sections.title: Ada masalah di kamar
lines: Budi
Hi, this is room 512. The air conditioning isn't working.
Halo, ini kamar 512. AC-nya tidak berfungsi.
Receptionist
I'm so sorry about that. I'll send someone up right away.
Mohon maaf. Saya segera kirim petugas ke atas.
Budi
Thank you. Also, could I have an extra towel, please?
Terima kasih. Juga, boleh minta handuk tambahan?
Receptionist
Of course. Anything else I can help you with?
Tentu. Ada lagi yang bisa saya bantu?
Budi
Could you tell me which direction the qibla is?
Bisa beri tahu arah kiblat?
Receptionist
Certainly, there's a qibla sticker on the ceiling above the desk.
Tentu, ada stiker kiblat di langit-langit di atas meja.

sections.title: Ungkapan kunci
items: I have a reservation under the name ...
Could I have an extra pillow / towel?
Could I have a late check-out?
Could you call me a taxi?

goals: Membeli obat dan meminta bantuan dalam keadaan darurat.

sections.html: Nomor darurat: 999 di Inggris, 911 di Amerika, 112 di Eropa, dan 000 di Australia. Untuk obat ringan, datangi pharmacy/chemist. Apoteker boleh memberi saran.
sections.title: 🌏 Tips budaya
Bertanya jalan
lines: Rina
Excuse me, how do I get to the nearest mosque?
Permisi, bagaimana cara ke masjid terdekat?
Local
Go straight down this road, then take the second left.
Lurus saja di jalan ini, lalu ambil belokan kiri kedua.
Rina
Second left... and then?
Belokan kiri kedua... lalu?
Local
Walk past the bank. The mosque is on your right, opposite the park.
Lewati bank. Masjidnya di kanan, di seberang taman.
Rina
Is it far from here?
Apakah jauh dari sini?
Local
Not really, about a ten-minute walk.
Tidak terlalu, sekitar sepuluh menit jalan kaki.

sections.title: Di apotek
lines: Pharmacist
Hello, how can I help?
Halo, ada yang bisa dibantu?
Budi
I have a headache and a sore throat. Can you recommend something?
Saya sakit kepala dan sakit tenggorokan. Bisa sarankan obat?
Pharmacist
Do you have a fever? Are you allergic to any medicine?
Apakah demam? Ada alergi obat?
Budi
No fever, and no allergies.
Tidak demam dan tidak ada alergi.
Pharmacist
Take these tablets twice a day after meals, and these lozenges for your throat.
Minum tablet ini dua kali sehari setelah makan, dan permen pelega ini untuk tenggorokan.
Budi
Thank you. Are these gelatine-free?
Terima kasih. Apakah ini bebas gelatin?
